mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 78 degrees by Fireman's Park under a new moon. Tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 62 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, the Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This new long-range vision focuses on creating strong neighborhoods, supporting our local manufacturing and technology sectors, and fostering a vibrant downtown environment.
There is plenty happening around town, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at trivia nights hosted at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at the weekly police report, on October 3, officers arrested a 19-year-old local man who was found to be in possession of a stolen firearm during a traffic stop.

Today's flavor is Georgia Peach. The restaurant is currently open, but please note they will be closing in 38 minutes, so you have just enough time to grab a scoop before they shut their doors for the night.
